attchmntText: Expleo Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Expleo Solutions Limited has disclosed that the audio recording of the investor call held on November 16, 2026, is available on the company website. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III and Regulation 46(2)(oa) of SEBI Listing Regulations. The recording can be accessed at https://expleogroup.com/expleo-solutions/media-center/. The notice was issued by S. Sampath Kumar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 16, 2026.

attchmntText: Expleo Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Expleo Solutions Limited has submitted newspaper advertisements regarding the publication of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in the Financial Express All India Edition and Makkal Kural. This submission is made pursuant to Regulation 47(3) of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The information is also available on the company website at https://investors.expleo.com. The filing was signed by S. Sampath Kumar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, with membership number FCS 3838. The notice was issued on November 15, 2026, in Chennai.

attchmntText: Expleo Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "H1FY27 Operating Revenue up by 7.7% Y-o-Y to Rs 5,842 million; PAT grew by 10.1% YoY".
voiceSummary: Expleo Solutions Limited announced financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Operating revenue for the half year grew 7.7% year-on-year to Rs 5,842 million. Profit after tax increased by 10.1% year-on-year to Rs 747 million. For the second quarter, operating revenue was Rs 2,926 million, up 3.5% year-on-year. Profit after tax for the quarter stood at Rs 393 million. Basic earnings per share were Rs 23.45 for the quarter. The company's net cash position was Rs 2,757 million. Results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Expleo Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Expleo Solutions Limited submitted its earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the BSE and NSE. Operating revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs 2,926 million, up 0.4% quarter-on-quarter and 3.5% year-on-year. Adjusted EBITDA stood at Rs 404 million, down 4.5% from Q1 FY27 and 16.2% from Q2 FY26. The adjusted EBITDA margin was 13.8%. Profit after tax was Rs 393 million, an increase of 11.3% from Q1 FY27 but a decrease of 8.7% from Q2 FY26. Basic earnings per share were Rs 23.45. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, operating revenue was Rs 5,842 million, up 7.7% year-on-year. Adjusted EBITDA was Rs 828 million, up 1.6% year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs 747 million, up 10.1% year-on-year. The net cash position was Rs 2,757 million.

attchmntText: Expleo Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Mr. Bastien Georges Andre Lefranc as Additional Director of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Expleo Solutions Limited appointed Mr. Bastien Georges Andre Lefranc, DIN 11768456, as Additional Director, Non-Executive, Non-Independent, with effect from November 14, 2026. The Board approved this appointment based on the Nomination and Remuneration Committee's recommendation. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Lefranc is the Group Chief Financial Officer of Expleo Group. He has 25 years of experience in corporate finance. He is not related to any existing directors of the company. He is not debarred from holding the office of director by SEBI or any other authority.

attchmntText: Expleo Solutions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Expleo Solutions Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the appointment of Mr. Bastien Georges Andre Lefranc, with DIN 11768456, as Additional Director, subject to shareholder approval. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 5156.01 million, with a profit after tax of Rs. 606.00 million. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 39.05. The company decided to discontinue publishing quarterly results for the remainder of the financial year 2026-27.

attchmntText: Expleo Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Expleo Solutions Limited will announce its Second Quarter and Half Year results for FY 2027 on Saturday, November 14, 2026. An earnings conference call with analysts and investors is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, from 11:30 AM to 12:30 PM IST. The call will feature Mr. Ralph Gillessen, Chairperson; Mr. Phani Tangirala, Managing Director and CEO; and Mr. Periakaruppan Palaniappan, Chief Financial Officer. Participants may dial in using the provided numbers or join via Diamond Pass. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of SEBI Listing Regulations.
